# Checklists

Run the list for each area you touched. Each line names the rules behind it.

## Before you start

- [ ] Read the project's instructions (`A-1`).
- [ ] Name the layer that owns the change (`BE-SVC-1`, `FE-MGR-1`).

## Before merge

- [ ] The local checks are the pipeline's checks (`D-1`).
- [ ] Findings carry evidence (`R-2`).
